errors.evidence: The green bars are not all around 80–82%; several are closer to about 79.5–81.6%, with the lowest green bars below 80%.
The red bars are roughly 71.6–73.6%, so the stated range is slightly broader and somewhat imprecise.
The description does not mention that each category is shown as a grouped pair of adjacent bars with two shades within each color group.
The description does not mention that the bars are ordered from left to right by color/group (blue, green, red, orange), nor that the x-axis labels are rotated diagonally.
